name: Yano Kazuya
source:
A detective with the Criminal Investigation Division of the Manseibashi Police Station, First Area Headquarters, Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department.
Despite his young age, he is already a rising star who has handled and led investigations into numerous criminal cases.
Though he appears calm and collected, his passion for investigations is extraordinarily intense. He has made all kinds of criminals confess through his commanding way with words and penetrating gaze.
Despite his impressive track record, he rarely speaks about his past.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4131220?emclan=103582791475366169&emgid=705529654727934533]Steam announcement[/url]]
